properties.evidence: The hazard this idea carried was hydrate cost: with the store gone, every session pays a rebuild, and that was 8,828 ms when the question was first recorded — enough to make the idea unusable for a design this size. The write-buffer index removed the cause (a linearly-scanned Vec, not storage), and load to fully searchable is now 1,098 ms with the full-text index built in RAM. The change did not decide the question; it removed the objection that would have decided it the other way.
